name: Render
description: Render is a cloud platform for deploying and scaling web services, static sites, background workers, cron jobs, private services, and databases, positioned as "the cloud for builders."
best_for: Developers and teams migrating from Heroku, Railway, or Fly.io, plus startups and builders who want straightforward deployment with minimal infrastructure management.
features: Autoscaling that automatically adjusts resources based on demand
Private networking for secure communication between services
Persistent disks for durable application storage
Infrastructure as Code for defining and managing infrastructure programmatically
Preview environments for testing changes before production
Render API, CLI, and MCP integration for agent-driven workflows

alternatives.name: Vercel

alternatives.name: Netlify
alternatives.description: A platform to create with AI or code and deploy instantly on production infrastructure.
